description: Repairs broken JSON: markdown fences, comments, trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, Python literals (True, False, None) and truncated endings. Pure code first; the model is asked once only when code cannot repair it. Optional JSON Schema check covers type, required, properties, items, enum, minimum, maximum, minLength, maxLength and pattern. Input max 1 MB. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema to validate the repaired value against
